name: outlook-mcp
description: Cloudflare Workers Model Context Protocol server bridging Claude to Microsoft Outlook + Teams — email (incl. threaded draft replies/reply-all/forward that preserve the conversation for later review/send), calendar, contacts, tasks, files (incl. OneDrive simple-upload for host-then-share workflows like .vcf contact cards), Teams meeting recordings + transcripts (incl. recent-recording discovery, ad-hoc / Meet-now, server-side subject search). 37 tools across 7 domains. Proxied Microsoft Graph OAuth 2.0. Built on @bashco/mcp-toolkit.
author: Bashar Basheer
